name: 012.[TRACKING] 낙찰 결과 역추적 및 자기강화 파이프라인 (V4.0.1)

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ ({
  status: '낙찰',
  actual_bid_price: $json.actual_bid_price,
  actual_bid_rate: $json.actual_bid_rate,
  bidder_count: $json.bidder_count > 0 ? $json.bidder_count : null,
  result_fetched_at: $json.fetched_at,
  bid_engine_error: $json.engine_error,
  loss_count: $json.new_loss_count,
  court: $json.new_court,
  item_no: $json.new_item_no || null,
  last_checked: new Date().toISOString().replace('T', ' ').substring(0, 19)
}) }}

={{ (() => { const j = $('결과 파싱').item.json; const n = (v) => (v === undefined || v === '' ? null : v); const ap = Number(j.appraisal_price) || 0; const mp = Number(j.sale_min_price) || 0; const rate = j.actual_bid_rate; return {
  case_no: j.case_no || '',
  item_no: j.new_item_no || null,
  court: j.new_court || '',
  location: j.location || '',
  sgg: j.sgg || '',
  emd: j.emd || '',
  usage: j.usage || '',
  detail_uid: j.detail_uid || null,
  result_type: '매각',
  complex_name: j.complex_name || '',
  dong: j.dong || '',
  area_m2: n(j.area_m2),
  floor: j.floor || '',
  appraisal_price: n(j.appraisal_price),
  min_price: mp || null,
  min_price_rate: ap && mp ? Math.round(mp / ap * 1000) / 10 : null,
  loss_count: n(j.new_loss_count),
  actual_bid_price: n(j.actual_bid_price),
  actual_bid_rate: n(rate),
  bidder_count: j.bidder_count > 0 ? j.bidder_count : null,
  bid_date: String(j.bid_date || '').replace(/\./g, '-').slice(0, 10),
  our_bid_target: j.bid_target || null,
  engine_error_rate: n(j.engine_error),
  engine_version: 'v3',
  fetched_at: j.fetched_at || '',
  real_trade_3m_avg: j.real_trade_3m_avg || null,
  real_trade_6m_avg: j.real_trade_6m_avg || null,
  market_price: j.real_trade_3m_avg || null,
  bid_vs_trade_gap_amt: n(j.bid_vs_trade_gap_amt),
  bid_vs_trade_gap_rate: n(j.bid_vs_trade_gap_rate),
  gap_score: n(j.gap_score),
  source: 'tracked',
  item_ref: j.Id || null,
  ai_risk: j.ai_risk || null,
  tenant_count: Number(j.tenant_count) >= 0 ? Number(j.tenant_count) : null,
  inherited_amount: n(j.inherited_amount),
  is_share: !!j.is_share,
  is_outlier: (rate !== null && rate !== undefined && (rate < 5 || rate > 200)) || (ap > 0 && mp > ap * 1.05)
}; })() }}

={{ ({
  status: '진행중',
  loss_count: $json.new_loss_count,
  prev_loss_count: $json.loss_count || 0,
  prev_min_price: $json.min_price || 0,
  min_price: $json.new_min_price,
  bid_date: $json.next_bid_date,
  court: $json.new_court,
  item_no: $json.new_item_no || null,
  last_checked: new Date().toISOString().replace('T', ' ').substring(0, 19),
  ...($json.engine || {})
}) }}
